steps.note: Dahi is thinned with about its own volume of water, warm or cold by the weather.
Churned by hand or motor at the ambient temperature, usually a cool morning.
The fat gathers in lumps on top and is lifted off, leaving the sour buttermilk (chhach or lassi).
